Another thrower uses your casting ability modifier and their own attack eligibility; resolve the transfer at the table. A sling uses its own range and applicable properties; the 60-ft thrown range does not replace the sling’s range. No inventory pebble or attack is spent automatically.

A target immune to Charmed automatically succeeds on the initial save. On a failed save it is Restrained and cannot see or hear beyond the illusion. Resolve target conditions and Concentration at the table.

effects.label: Initial save · full damage either way

notes: Intelligence save: 5d10 Psychic damage on either success or failure, not half on success. Success ends the spell; only failure creates the prison.

Only after the initial save failed: moving the target out, a melee attack through the illusion, or reaching any body part through it triggers 10d10 Psychic damage and ends the spell. No additional saving throw. Confirm the trigger at the table.
Choose water in up to a 100-ft cube within 300 ft; maintain Concentration. An Action on your turn can repeat or change the effect. Track water, vehicles, object outcomes and recipients at the table.

Raise standing water by up to 20 ft, or create a 20-ft wave in a large body. The wave carries Huge or smaller vehicles and has a 25% capsizing chance for them; repeat the wave at the start of your next turn while this effect remains. No automatic creature damage.
Open a trench through the chosen area. When this effect ends, water returns over the following round.
Direct flow within the area, including over obstacles; beyond it, water resumes its natural flow.

Requires water at least 50 ft square and 25 ft deep. The vortex is 25 ft high, 5 ft wide at its base and up to 50 ft wide at its top. Creatures and objects in water within 25 ft are pulled 10 ft toward it. A creature first entering on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Strength save; success halves damage. Failure also catches it; escaping once caught costs an Action and its Athletics check has Disadvantage. Object damage is a separate event.
An object takes 2d8 Bludgeoning on its first entry each turn, and each round it remains in the vortex. No creature save; resolve object damage rules at the table.

Choose water in up to a 100-ft cube within 300 ft; maintain Concentration. On later turns, a Magic action can repeat or change the effect. Track water, vehicles, object outcomes and recipients at the table.

Raise standing water by up to 20 ft, or create a 20-ft wave in a large body. The wave carries Huge or smaller vehicles and has a 25% capsizing chance for them; repeat the wave at the start of your next turn while this effect remains. No automatic creature damage.
Open a trench through the chosen area. When this effect ends, water returns over the following round.
Direct flow within the area, including over obstacles; beyond it, water resumes its natural flow.

Requires water at least 50 ft square and 25 ft deep. The vortex is 25 ft high, 5 ft wide at its base and up to 50 ft wide at its top. Creatures in water within 25 ft are pulled 10 ft toward it. A creature first entering on a turn or ending its turn inside makes a Strength save; success halves damage. Swimming away requires an Action and a successful Athletics check; this source does not impose the legacy caught condition or its Disadvantage.

Reaction casting requires taking Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage. The actual casting grants Resistance to that triggering type until the start of your next turn. Only your first melee-attack hit on that next turn adds the chosen damage, then the spell ends; other melee hits and earlier or later turns do not qualify. Match the stored type to the actual trigger. Selecting this reference does not cast, spend a Reaction/slot or grant Resistance.

Touch one creature and choose one curse when casting. An initial Wisdom save prevents the curse on success. Only a failed save enables its chosen effect. Remove Curse ends it; track the recipient and actual casting at the table. The nature choices do not add several curses from one casting.
After a failed initial save, the cursed target has Disadvantage on Strength ability checks and saving throws. Other abilities are unchanged.
After a failed initial save, the cursed target has Disadvantage on Dexterity ability checks and saving throws. Other abilities are unchanged.
After a failed initial save, the cursed target has Disadvantage on Constitution ability checks and saving throws. Other abilities are unchanged.
After a failed initial save, the cursed target has Disadvantage on Intelligence ability checks and saving throws. Other abilities are unchanged.

After a failed initial save, the cursed target has Disadvantage on Charisma ability checks and saving throws. Other abilities are unchanged.
After a failed initial save, the cursed target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you; attacks against other creatures are unchanged.

After a failed initial save, the target makes a Wisdom save at the start of each of its turns. Failure wastes its Action doing nothing. Success permits its Action this turn; it does not end the curse.

After a failed initial save and choosing this curse: your attacks and spells deal an extra 1d8 Necrotic to that target. This is only the extra damage, not a separate attack or the initial curse’s damage. Slot level changes duration, not this d8. Resolve separate damage events with the DM.
The DM chooses and adjudicates a comparable alternative. Record its actual terms in your notes; this option supplies no automatic target effect or damage.

After a failed initial save, the cursed target has Disadvantage on Wisdom ability checks and saving throws. Other abilities are unchanged.
After a failed initial save, the cursed target has Disadvantage on Charisma ability checks and saving throws. Other abilities are unchanged.
After a failed initial save, the cursed target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you; attacks against other creatures are unchanged.

After a failed initial save, a combat turn-start Wisdom save can force the target to take the Dodge action on that turn. A successful save does not end the curse. This is not the legacy wasted-Action effect; other actions follow the normal Dodge rules.

After a failed initial save and choosing this curse, damage you deal with an attack roll or a spell causes the target to take an extra 1d8 Necrotic. Confirm that you actually dealt the triggering damage. This is only the extra damage; slot level changes duration, not this d8.

On casting, choose one visible creature within 90 ft and one damage type. Extra targets from higher slots must be within 30 ft of each other. A failed Constitution save removes only Resistance to the chosen type, not Immunity. Each affected target taking that type’s damage for the first time each turn takes this extra 2d6 of that type; damage need not come from you. Maintain Concentration up to one minute. Casting itself deals none of this damage. Track targets, triggering damage and each target’s turn limit at the table.

You and nonhostile creatures must be inside your moving 30-ft-radius aura. Only a weapon-attack hit adds this rider; this source does not add it to an ordinary Unarmed Strike. This is only the extra damage; resolve the original attack separately. Slot level never increases this die. Confirm actual casting and Concentration, aura occupancy and the attacker’s own modifiers at the table; selecting a reference does not activate an aura.

You and allies must be inside your 30-ft Emanation. A qualifying weapon or Unarmed Strike hit adds this rider. This is only the extra damage; resolve the original attack separately. Slot level never increases this die. Confirm actual casting and Concentration, aura occupancy and the attacker’s own modifiers at the table; selecting a reference does not activate an aura.

Touch a weapon when casting; Concentration lasts up to 1 hour. While active it counts as magical and emits bright light 30 ft plus another 30 ft of dim light. A reference does not enchant inventory, activate light, cast, dismiss the spell, spend a Bonus Action or change target conditions. Neither damage event increases with slot level.

Only a hit from a weapon attack using this actual enchanted weapon adds the rider. Resolve the original weapon attack, its range and the attacker’s own modifiers separately; it is not another spell attack or a separate saving throw.

On your turn, spend a Bonus Action to dismiss the spell. Choose creatures you can see within 30 ft of the weapon, not necessarily of you. Each makes a CON save: success halves damage; failure also causes Blinded for 1 minute. Repeat CON at each affected creature’s turn end to end its Blinded condition. Confirm the actual dismissal and remove the weapon’s former benefits at the table.

Bonus Action casting; Concentration up to 1 minute. Choose Radiant, Necrotic or Cold when casting and retain that choice. Extra damage applies to your attack hit only when the creature is within 10 ft of you; a distant hit or a different attacker does not qualify. Only the rider is shown: resolve the original attack separately. A creature taking this damage cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Type, proximity, actual casting/Concentration and target effects remain table checks; a reference does not activate the spell.

effects.label: Visible creature starts turn · speed reduction

notes: Choose a creature you can see that starts its turn within 10 ft of you. Its speed is reduced by 10 ft until the start of your next turn. This trigger requires neither a hit nor the extra-damage roll. Resolve affected movement at the table.

Bonus Action casting; Concentration up to 1 minute. While the spell lasts, your speed increases and your movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. Selecting either reference does not cast, activate a speed bonus, move you or spend resources.

effects.label: Move near creature or unattended object · heat trail

notes: Only when you move within 5 ft of a creature or an object that is not worn or carried. The eligible creature or object takes the displayed Fire damage without an attack roll or saving throw, at most once during any one turn. This is per turn, not per round; moving past the same target repeatedly in a turn adds no damage. Resolve actual positions, target eligibility and HP at the table.

Bonus Action casting; Concentration up to 1 minute. Only your qualifying weapon hit gains this extra Radiant damage. It does not grant another attack or add the rider to an ordinary Unarmed Strike. Resolve the original attack separately; slot level never increases this die. Selecting a reference does not cast, activate the benefit, spend slots or change weapon damage.

Bonus Action casting; 1 minute, no Concentration. Only your qualifying weapon hit gains this extra Radiant damage. It does not grant another attack or add the rider to an ordinary Unarmed Strike. Resolve the original attack separately; slot level never increases this die. Selecting a reference does not cast, activate the benefit, spend slots or change weapon damage.

Action casting, touch one nonmagical weapon; Concentration up to 1 hour. The weapon becomes magical and gains the slot’s attack-roll bonus plus this extra damage on a hit. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder when casting and retain that choice. The attack bonus is not a flat damage bonus; slots 7–9 remain +3 and 3d4. Resolve the original weapon attack and the attacker’s modifiers separately. A reference does not enchant equipment, cast, activate a bonus or spend resources.

Action casting, touch one nonmagical weapon; Concentration up to 1 hour. The weapon becomes magical and gains the slot’s attack-roll bonus plus this extra damage on a hit. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder when casting and retain that choice. The attack bonus is not a flat damage bonus; slots 7–9 remain +3 and 3d4. Resolve the original weapon attack and the attacker’s modifiers separately. A reference does not enchant equipment, cast, activate a bonus or spend resources.

Action casting, touch a quiver with arrows or bolts; Concentration up to 1 hour. A ranged weapon hit using ammunition drawn from this quiver adds the displayed Fire damage. A miss adds none. Each piece loses this magic after a hit or miss, and drawing the slot’s full allowance ends the spell. Higher slots increase affected ammunition, not the 1d6 damage. Resolve the actual weapon attack, draws, target HP and Concentration at the table; a reference creates no ammunition, changes no stock and does not cast or spend slots.

Bonus Action casting; Concentration up to 1 minute. While the spell lasts, your movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. Once before it ends, choose one weapon attack roll on your own turn and give it Advantage. Only that attack can gain the extra Force damage on a hit. This is once per casting, not once per turn. Selecting a reference does not cast, spend resources or activate either movement benefit.

effects.label: Chosen Advantage weapon attack hits · extra damage

notes: Resolve the original weapon attack and its range separately. A miss adds no extra damage but still triggers the short walking-speed benefit. Slot level does not increase this die.

effects.label: Chosen attack hits or misses · walking speed

notes: After the one chosen attack, whether it hits or misses, your walking speed increases by 30 ft until the end of that turn. This short benefit does not last for the whole spell. Resolve the actual turn and movement at the table.

Concentration up to 10 minutes. The wall can be up to 60 × 10 × 5 ft; it blocks sight but allows creatures and objects through. Light extends 120 ft bright plus another 120 ft dim. Select the actual event; references do not cast, create a wall, track its length or apply target damage/conditions.
Only when the wall appears: success halves damage and prevents Blinded; failure causes Blinded for 1 minute. Repeat CON at the end of each blinded creature’s turn, ending that condition on success.
A creature ending its turn in the wall takes this damage without another saving throw or attack roll. This event does not add the initial Blinded effect.

Action: one creature you can see within 60 ft of the wall, using a ranged spell attack. Hit deals the displayed damage. Hit or miss shortens the wall by 10 ft; length 0 ends the spell. Confirm actual remaining wall length before this action.

Concentration up to 1 minute. Select a visible point for the cube and resolve only natural features actually present there. No reference creates trees, rocks or ground cover, starts Concentration, spends actions or changes target conditions/HP. Damage does not increase with slot level.
Grass/undergrowth-covered ground in the cube is Difficult Terrain for your enemies. Other ground and friendly creatures are not covered by this effect.

effects.label: Start of your turn · tree branches

combat.actionRange: Enemies within 10 ft of a tree in cube
notes: At the start of each of your turns, enemies within 10 ft of any tree in the cube make DEX saves. Success prevents all this damage; failure takes the displayed Slashing damage.

effects.label: End of your turn · roots and vines

notes: At each own-turn end, choose one grounded creature in the cube. Failed STR save causes Restrained until the spell ends. The target can spend an Action on the listed Athletics check to end Restrained on itself.

On your turn, a Bonus Action launches one loose rock in the cube at a visible creature in the cube. Use a ranged spell attack. On a hit the displayed Bludgeoning damage is nonmagical; the hit creature also makes a STR save or falls Prone. A miss deals none and forces no rider save.

Choose the glyph’s trigger and effect when casting; an object moved more than 10 ft from the casting position breaks its glyph without triggering. A surface glyph covers at most a 10-ft-diameter area. Once triggered, its 60-ft-radius sphere lasts 10 minutes. It affects creatures present at activation, first entering on a turn, or ending a turn there. Resolve the legacy entry and turn-end events as written; do not borrow the revised once-per-turn limit. Slot level does not increase damage. A reference does not inscribe/trigger a glyph, pay costs, make choices again, or apply target conditions.
Failed save: 10d10 Necrotic; success halves damage.
Failed save: for 1 minute, meaningful communication is impossible and attack rolls/ability checks have Disadvantage.
Failed save: Frightened for 1 minute; move at least 30 ft from the glyph each turn if able. The frightened target also drops held objects.
Failed save: for 1 minute, the target cannot attack or target creatures with harmful abilities, spells or magic.
Failed save: for 1 minute, no actions, comprehension or reading; speech is gibberish and the DM handles erratic movement.
Failed save: Incapacitated for 1 minute.
Failed save: Unconscious for 10 minutes; damage or an Action spent shaking/slapping the target wakes it.
Failed save: Stunned for 1 minute.

Concentration up to 1 minute. The initial WIS save prevents the spell on success; failure prevents Reactions and requires a d10 roll at each target turn start. Select the result actually rolled; never choose a preferred result instead. The target repeats WIS at each turn end to end the whole spell. No damage occurs just from the initial failed save. A reference does not roll the table, teleport the target, apply conditions or spend resources. Slot level never increases damage.

effects.label: Rolled 1–2 · Vision of the Far Realm

notes: Automatic damage for this rolled result; no additional damage save. Stunned lasts until the end of this turn.
This rolled result requires its separate DEX save; success halves the displayed Force damage.

Automatic damage; no additional save. Teleport the target with its worn/carried equipment up to 30 ft to a visible unoccupied space you choose, then apply Prone. Resolve the actual destination at the table.

effects.label: Rolled 9–10 · Chill of the Dark Void

notes: Automatic damage; no additional save. Blinded lasts until the end of this turn.
